description: "Use when the user asks direct knowledge questions or concept comparisons (e.g. what is X, difference between X and Y, how something works) and does not ask to read, create, modify, or search notes files."
name: "Direct Knowledge Answer"

# Direct Knowledge Q&A Standards

- When the user asks a pure knowledge question, answer directly from general knowledge.
- Do not proactively read note files or search the workspace notes.
- Do not proactively create, modify, or supplement any note document.
- Only enter note-related workflows when the user explicitly asks to "check my notes / based on my notes / add to my notes / edit my notes".
- Answer accurately and concisely; being inside the notes workspace is not a reason to default to editing notes.
